mechanism.statement: Due animal production is capped at max_held; pre-EOD HARVEST can recover only the clipping attributable to already-held product.

trust_boundary_hardening.engine_invariant: private.inventories is exactly [main_farmer, *hands]; HIRE appends the hand and inventory row together and EOD clears hands while resetting inventories to one farmer row.
trust_boundary_hardening.guard: capacity proof refuses any private inventory cardinality different from current actor cardinality
trust_boundary_hardening.regression: a two-actor truncated inventory vector that would undercount carried goods and falsely fit a 4-unit HARVEST now returns malformed_capacity_state
